title: Mabel Mays on Yard Lawn, Picket Fence - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid snapshot from the 1940s showing Mabel Mays sitting on a grassy suburban yard next to a small evergreen bush framed by a miniature decorative white picket fence. She wears a patterned dress and features a neatly curled hairstyle characteristic of the wartime era.
